reproduction.rationale: Original Table 1 fixed-HMP-target prediction task across all nine targets and both instructions. Reproduction recreates the complete three-author-law panel: 54 held-contrast RMSE references, 54 full-fit latency R² references and 18 Fechner accuracy R² companions. Improvement evaluates one arbitrary candidate method on the 18 target×instruction cells against the strongest relevant original author law preselected separately for each cell before inspecting candidate performance; three candidate law variants are not required. Original fixed targets, B/H populations, source contrast folds and complete support are unchanged. Broader EEG event discovery, mixed effects and ERP/CPP findings remain separately named reproduction. Reconstruct all original linear/Pieron/Fechner reference laws on the identical fixed HMP targets, B/H populations and source folds. Preselect the strongest relevant source author comparator separately for each of18 target×instruction cells before seeing candidate predictions or errors, preserving published versus qualified native-rerun provenance and a declared tie policy. An arbitrary candidate supplies one18-cell error vector; its18×3 comparison matrix is54 reported contrasts, not54 required candidate outputs. Full-panel superiority and uncertainty policy remain unresolved. Authenticate original512-Hz fixed HMP targets and cleaned epochs, participant identities and B/H responded/correct masks; no alternative target fitting. Reconstruct all source global contrast grids and per-participant fits/reductions and compare complete126reference panel. Retain Table1/Results encoding R² discrepancy with table-specific numeric provenance; do not choose favorable values. Predeclare the strongest original comparator for each of18 target×instruction cells and a valid joint18-cell improvement rule. Preserve all126 author reproduction references;54 author RMSE cells and72 source R² companions do not require three candidate-method variants. Qualify native target/runtime parity, reproduced law baseline, scientifically justified tolerance/meaningful effect/paired participant uncertainty, budgets and independent complete support execution. Full-panel comparator and improvement admission require a source-faithful multi-endpoint comparison route; current scalar improvement engine cannot admit this vector. No invented mean, win count or easy source cell may replace complete support. Actual input/exposure/reference manifests and paired runtime remain unqualified.
